title: Study: Millions of Europeans Could Die from Heat by 2100
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A new study warns that millions of Europeans could die from heat-related causes by the end of the century.
sentences.zh: 一项新的研究警告说,到本世纪末,数百万欧洲人可能死于与热有关的疾病。

sentences.en: The study was based on computer simulations of predicted climate activity in 854 different European cities.
sentences.zh: 这项研究以854个欧洲城市预测气候活动的计算机模拟为基础。

sentences.en: It found that extreme temperatures, mostly heat, could kill as many as 2.3 million people in Europe by 2100.
sentences.zh: 研究发现,到2100年,欧洲的极端温度,主要是热度,可能会杀死230万人。

sentences.en: The researchers said the number of predicted deaths could be reduced if nations are able to find better ways of cutting carbon pollution levels and dealing with extreme heat.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说,如果各国能够找到更好的办法降低碳污染水平和处理极端热量,预计的死亡人数就可以减少。

sentences.en: Currently, cold weather kills far more people in Europe than hot weather.
sentences.zh: 目前,寒冷的天气在欧洲杀死的人远多于热天。

sentences.en: But the study found that as temperatures continue to rise, deaths from cold weather will lessen over time.
sentences.zh: 但研究发现,随着气温继续上升,寒冷天气造成的死亡将随着时间的推移而减少。

sentences.en: However, heat-related deaths are predicted to rise sharply.
sentences.zh: 然而,与热有关的死亡预计会急剧上升。

sentences.en: Scientists at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine led the research.
sentences.zh: 伦敦卫生和热带医学学院的科学家领导了这项研究。

sentences.en: The results appeared recently in a study in the publication Nature Medicine .
sentences.zh: 最新结果出现在《自然医学》一书中。

sentences.en: The researchers urged increased efforts to reduce greenhouse gases and expand indoor air-cooling systems and cooling centers in parts of Europe.
sentences.zh: 研究人员敦促在欧洲部分地区加强努力,减少温室气体,扩大室内空气冷却系统和冷却中心。

sentences.en: Without such efforts, places in Italy, southern Spain and Greece are likely to see large increases in heat deaths related to climate change, the study found.
sentences.zh: 研究发现,如果没有这些努力,意大利、西班牙南部和希腊的热量死亡可能因气候变化而大量增加。

sentences.en: On the other hand, much of Scandinavia and Britain are predicted to see fewer temperature-related deaths, largely because low temperatures are expected to become more moderate.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,预计斯堪的纳维亚和英国大部分地区与温度有关的死亡率将减少,这主要是因为低温预计会变得更温和。

sentences.en: Pierre Masselot studies the environmental effects of human health at the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.
sentences.zh: Pierre Masselot在伦敦卫生和热带医学学院研究人类健康对环境的影响。

sentences.en: He helped lead the research. Masselot told the Associated Press that drops in cold deaths in northern parts of Europe are happening in areas not as populated as places further south. “The Mediterranean is a so-called climate hotspot," he said.
sentences.zh: Masselot告诉美联社说,欧洲北部冷死率下降发生在人口不及南边的地区。 他说 : “ 地中海是所谓的气候热点。 ”

sentences.en: "It's a region that is warming much quicker than the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: "这个区域变暖的速度比世界其他地方快得多"

sentences.en: And Malta is right in the middle of it.” The study predicts Malta’s temperature-related deaths will increase by 269 people for every 100,000 individuals by the end of the century.
sentences.zh: 马耳他正处在中间。 这项研究预测,到本世纪末,马耳他每100 000人中与温度有关的死亡人数将增加269人。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Ireland’s rate is expected to drop slightly to 15 per 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,爱尔兰的增长率预计将略降至每10万人15人。

sentences.en: European officials reported several heat waves have killed thousands of people in recent years across the continent.
sentences.zh: 据欧洲官员报告,近年来,在非洲大陆各地,几起热浪已造成数千人死亡。

sentences.en: The highest number was in 2003, when about 70,000 deaths were recorded.
sentences.zh: 死亡人数最多的是2003年,当时记录了大约70 000人死亡。

sentences.en: Among the areas predicted to see the most deaths from future temperature rises is Barcelona, Spain.
sentences.zh: 预计未来气温上升导致死亡人数最多的地区是西班牙巴塞罗那。

sentences.en: The study found almost 250,000 people could die from temperature-related causes in that city by 2100.
sentences.zh: 该研究发现,到2100年,该市有将近250 000人可能死于与温度有关的疾病。

sentences.en: And the study warned that Rome and Naples could have up to 150,000 deaths.
sentences.zh: 研究报告警告说,罗马和那不勒斯可能有多达15万人死亡。

sentences.en: The study predicted that more than 5.8 million extra heat deaths would be linked to climate change.
sentences.zh: 研究预测,超过580万的超热死亡与气候变化有关。

sentences.en: At the same time, the study found cold-related deaths would drop by 3.5 million.
sentences.zh: 与此同时,研究发现,与寒冷有关的死亡人数将减少350万。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. The Associated Press reported on this story.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩・林恩 美联社报导了这个故事

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn改编了VOA学习英语的报告。
